commit_message: Extract Tile Map collision by sparse chunk
pr_title: GameEngine: complete ADR0127 Native 2D first release
pr_body: Connects compiled Tile Set/Tile Map collision data to the dedicated Native 2D physics world as chunk-owned fixed collision sources. Tile cells do not become ECS entities; contacts, ray/box casts, overlaps, CharacterController2D, materials, and one-way policy reuse the existing 2D solver and report the owning TileMap entity.
